kicker.zh-Hans: 一个 App · 装所有游戏

title.zh-Hans: 装一次 S2Arm，游戏一款一款加进去
title.en: Install S2Arm once, then add games one by one

what.zh-Hans: 以前每款游戏是一个单独的 App；现在手机上**只有一个 S2Arm**，所有游戏都在它的游戏库里。
what.en: Games used to be separate apps; now there is **one S2Arm** on your phone and every game is in its library.

how.zh-Hans: 先在电脑上把 S2Arm 装到手机，以后哪款想玩就把哪款「**推到 iPhone**」。S2Arm 更新时**不用重新推游戏**，存档也都在。
how.en: Install S2Arm on your phone from the computer, then **Send to iPhone** whichever game you want to play. Updating S2Arm **doesn't mean sending games again**, and your saves stay.

where.zh-Hans: iPhone 主屏上的 S2Arm 图标，打开就是游戏库。
where.en: The S2Arm icon on your iPhone Home Screen opens the library.

kicker.zh-Hans: 新的出包方式 · 两个按钮各管一件事
kicker.en: A new way to add games · One button for each job

title.zh-Hans: 「一键出包」拆成了两步：装 App、推游戏
title.en: One-click export is now two steps: install the app, send the game

what.zh-Hans: 以前一键出包会把游戏和 App 打成一个包；现在拆开了：**手机条只管 S2Arm 这个 App**（安装、续签、更新），每款游戏的「**推到 iPhone**」**只管这一款**。
what.en: Export used to build the game and the app into one package. Now **the phone bar handles the S2Arm app** (install, renew, update) and each game's **Send to iPhone handles just that game**.

how.zh-Hans: 第一次：连上手机，点手机条上的「安装 S2Arm」。之后：选一款游戏，点「推到 iPhone」。快到 7 天时，手机条会提示「续签」，点一下就行，游戏不用重推。
how.en: The first time, connect your phone and click Install S2Arm on the phone bar. After that, pick a game and click Send to iPhone. When the 7 days are nearly up, the phone bar asks you to renew; one click, no games to send again.

where.zh-Hans: 原来的「一键出包」按钮，现在就是**游戏页上的「推到 iPhone」**；装 App、续签都在**启动器上方的手机条**里。
where.en: The old one-click export button is now **Send to iPhone on the game's page**; installing and renewing the app are on **the phone bar at the top of the launcher**.

kicker.zh-Hans: 从 0.5 升级 · 两步换到新 App
kicker.en: Upgrading from 0.5 · Two steps to the new app

title.zh-Hans: 老游戏和存档都在，点两下就接上
title.en: Your games and saves stay. Two clicks and you're back

what.zh-Hans: 0.6.0 起手机上统一用一个 S2Arm 装所有游戏。你手机上原来的游戏、存档、游戏数据**都会留着**，不用重新出包，也不用重传游戏数据。
what.en: From 0.6.0 there is one S2Arm app for all your games. The games, saves and game data already on your phone **all stay**; no exporting again, no sending game data again.

how.zh-Hans: ① Mac 玩家先在 S2Arm 里**用 Apple ID 登录一次**。② 连上手机，点手机条上的「**更新 S2Arm**」：先把各款存档备份到电脑，再换成新 App。③ 装完同一页列出这台手机上要更新的旧游戏，默认全勾，点「**更新这 N 款**」，每款约 1–2 分钟；旧版做的着色器库电脑会顺带重做，第一次要几分钟到几十分钟。**不用点 S 级优化**。
how.en: ① On a Mac, **sign in with your Apple ID once** in S2Arm. ② Connect your phone and click **Update S2Arm** on the phone bar: your saves are backed up to the computer first, then the new app goes on. ③ Right after, the same page lists the old games on this phone, all checked: click **Update these N games**, about 1–2 minutes each. Shader libraries built by the old version are rebuilt by the computer too; the first time takes from a few minutes to a few tens of minutes. **No need for S-grade optimization.**

where.zh-Hans: 第 ③ 步做完之前，这些游戏在手机上显示「**在电脑上更新一次**」，点不进去，但没丢。别的电脑装的另起一行列出，到那台电脑上更新。用 AltStore 等自己签名的：装新 S2Arm 覆盖旧的，再把每款 .s2arm 导入一次。
where.en: Until step ③ is done, those games show **Update once on your computer** on the phone and won't open, but they aren't gone. Games installed from another computer are listed on a separate line; update them on that computer. If you sign the app yourself with AltStore or similar: install the new S2Arm over the old one, then import each game's .s2arm once.

title.zh-Hans: 随时存下当前这一刻，下次从这里接着玩
title.en: Save the moment you're in and pick up right there next time

what.zh-Hans: 不用等游戏自己的存档点，点一下就把此刻的游戏状态整个存下来，之后能回到这一刻。
what.en: No need to wait for the game's own save point; one tap saves the whole game as it is right now, and you can come back to it.

how.zh-Hans: 游戏里点右上角的半透明按钮就存；长按它选「**回到上次存下的这一刻**」。下次打开游戏库，最上面的「**从这一刻继续**」点一下直接进。
how.en: In a game, tap the translucent button in the top-right corner to save; press and hold it and choose **Go back to the saved moment**. Next time, **Continue from this moment** at the top of the library takes you straight there.

where.zh-Hans: 每款只留最新一份，新存的会盖掉旧的。每份约 0.4～1 GB，占手机空间：长按可以删除，腾出空间；不想用可以在设置里关掉。快照只在存下它的那台设备上可用。
where.en: Each game keeps only the latest one, and a new save replaces the old. Each takes about 0.4–1 GB of your phone's storage: press and hold to delete it and free the space, or turn snapshots off in Settings. A snapshot only works on the device that saved it.

title.zh-Hans: 每款游戏一份文件，占多少一眼看清
title.en: One copy per game, and you can see what takes the space

what.zh-Hans: 每款游戏只占一份资源，不再重复存好几份；游戏、存档、快照各占多少空间，都列在一页里。
what.en: Each game keeps one copy of its files instead of several; games, saves and snapshots are listed on one page with their sizes.

how.zh-Hans: 空间不够时打开「释放空间」，挑不玩的删掉。想把游戏带到另一台设备，点「导出 .s2arm」，把文件发过去导入就行。
how.en: When space runs low, open Free up space and remove what you no longer play. To take a game to another device, click Export .s2arm and import the file there.

where.zh-Hans: 启动器游戏库里的「释放空间」；导出在每款游戏页的更多操作里。
where.en: Free up space in the launcher's library; Export is in each game's More menu.

title.en: No more hitch when you enter a new area

what.zh-Hans: 以前第一次走进一个新场景，画面常会顿一下；那是在临时准备画面要用的东西。现在推游戏的时候就准备好了。
what.en: The first time you walked into a new area, the picture often stuttered while the game got its graphics ready. Now that's done when you send the game.

how.zh-Hans: 什么都不用做。照常推游戏，会多花一点时间准备，之后第一次玩也顺。
how.en: Nothing to do. Send games as usual; it takes a little longer, and the first play is smooth.

where.zh-Hans: 所有新推的游戏都自动带上。之前推过的游戏，重新推一次就有了。
where.en: Every game you send from now on. For games sent before, send them again.
